title: Context-aware priority grid for data governance requests (logging/PII/retention/export)
creator: Priya Narayanan
description: Design a context-aware prioritization grid and guided intake flow for enterprise data-governance requests (log redaction, retention changes, PII export/remediation, audit exports). The grid should map request intent, legal/regulatory context, technical effort, risk, and required SLAs to a suggested priority and routing path (self-serve, SE-assisted, legal/Compliance review, or engineering project). The goal is to reduce manual triage time, set clear customer expectations, and ensure consistent, auditable decisions.
proposal: Introduce a 5-axis priority grid: Impact to customer (ops/legal/business), Data sensitivity (PII/PHI/none), Urgency (SLO/incident/feature), Implementation effort (config/workflow/code), Compliance requirement (statutory/internal).
Add a guided intake form that captures signals for each axis with contextual hints and mapping rules. The form will live in the Console support flow and via the partner intake API.

Automate initial routing: rules engine assigns to one of: self-serve config, Solutions Engineer triage, Legal/Compliance review, Engineering backlog with priority tag. Include human-in-the-loop override.
Produce standardized response templates, SLAs, and recommended remediation paths per cell in the grid. Templates include canned legal language, expected timelines, and data handling instructions.
Store all decisions and evidence in an auditable record linked to the customer account and ticket for future reviews and evals.
acceptance_criteria: Guided intake form implemented in Console and partner API capturing all five axes and free-form justification
Rule engine produces consistent routing suggestions for 90% of historical sample tickets (measure against dataset of 240 past requests)
Response templates covering common outcomes (approved, requires more info, declined, phased rollout) exist and are approved by Legal and Support
Audit trail created per ticket with metadata and decision rationale accessible to Compliance and Customer Success
Operational dashboard shows triage latency and accuracy metrics (goal: median triage time <= 1 business day)
Pilot completed with two enterprise customers and internal SEs with qualitative feedback captured
implementation_notes: Start with a lightweight rules engine (decision table) stored in Config Service; plan migration to rule DSL if complexity rises
Re-use existing Console intake components where possible; design new UI only for axis-specific hints and templates
Expose partner API fields in /v1/admin/requests intake to support SIs and channel partners
Coordinate with Legal on canonical classification examples for Data sensitivity axis
Add telemetry events for each intake field for later model-based improvements
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overly strict rules block legitimate customer requests. Mitigation: human-in-the-loop override and fallback to SE triage
Risk: Misclassification of PII leads to compliance exposure. Mitigation: conservative defaults, mandatory Legal review for 'high sensitivity' tags
Risk: Increased SLAs create operational load. Mitigation: tiered SLAs with clear cost/commitment implications and automated self-serve options
Risk: Audit trail contains sensitive data. Mitigation: redact fields in the audit view and restrict access to Compliance/Legal roles
